info.title: MICROSERVICE-testDev-Create Catalog Gardening Drill Detail-v1-spec
info.description: The Gardening Drill Details Catalog API enables users to add new gardening drill detail entries to the catalog. By utilizing this API, businesses can effectively manage their gardening drill inventory, ensuring that all information is up to date and accurately represented. This API is particularly useful for manufacturers, retailers, and suppliers looking to maintain comprehensive product details for customers. Key operations include submitting detailed specifications and attributes for gardening drills to enhance product visibility and selection.

post.summary: Create details for a gardening drill.
post.description: This endpoint allows you to submit detailed information regarding a gardening drill, enabling users to efficiently manage and document gardening tasks.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to provide detailed information for the gardening drill operation. It should contain all necessary parameters in JSON format as specified in the schema.

gardening_drill_id.description: The unique identifier for the gardening drill.

requestedBy.description: The name or identifier of the person requesting the operation.

quantity.description: The number of gardening drills requested.

isPriority.description: Indicates whether the request is a priority.

unitPrice.description: The price per unit of the gardening drill.

dimensions.description: The dimensions of the gardening drill.

warehouseCodes.description: A list of warehouse codes relevant to the request.

items.description: An identifier for the warehouse where the drills are stored.

CreateCatalogGardeningDrillDetailRequest.description: Schema representing the request body for the operations related to gardening drills.

width.description: The width of the gardening drill in specified units.

height.description: The height of the gardening drill in specified units.

unit.description: The unit of measurement for the dimensions (e.g., cm, inches).

Dimensions.description: Schema representing the dimensions of the gardening drill.
